note: The hacklab table (21 Nov). Table frame = ArUco marker 0 (bottom-left in the top camera): origin at its centre, x towards marker 3 (right), y towards marker 2 (towards the arms), z up; metres. Camera pose comes from the markers each run (perception/markers.py). Arm bases: read off the top-camera image, spacing set to 0.40 m centre to centre (measured gap 30 +-2 cm between the bases, SO-101 base ~10 cm wide); absolute position +-3-5 cm until measured from marker 2. Both arms face the camera (-y). Bowl: centre of its bottom, from the image.
